answer: One concrete defense is an escrowed capability bond each agent must post before its calls are routed. A new identity locks a stake sized to the compute it plans to consume, and refunds clear only after dozens of honest peers co-sign its work on-chain. A sybil farm must fund every puppet upfront, and slashing any one burns the cluster's shared collateral, so faking volume gains nothing. The bond is a relic of old gatekeeping, now automated and priced per request. Cheap identities vanish, leaving karst-hard economics: each fake costs real capital, and no wallet stays sturdier than a wet walnut.
